title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps rely on one accent colour and a red marker; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Raw data, trend and marker distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: a detrend that keeps the transit
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. The moving median of Session 3 keeps 94 percent of the transit depth; masking known transits does better.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: fit a limb-darkened transit
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses a coarse grid fit with a flat-star model.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5. Session 2 already has a limb-darkened light curve by grid integration.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app that fit k and b with the limb-darkened model and report uncertainties.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Radius ratio within 1 percent of the injected value on the demo curve
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: find a small planet in a spotted star
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a small planet recovered from a strongly varying star; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Detects the 600 ppm planet at SNR above 7
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Add a secondary-eclipse test to the vetting step
body:
## Problem
The odd-even check cannot catch a binary when BLS locks on its full orbit.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 'Unmask the binary'.

## Expected outcome
A function that measures the folded depth at phase 0.5 and flags significant dips there.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The Session 3 binary is flagged with its true 6.0 day orbit
- [ ] The planet in the demo is not flagged

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
